title: Finish the original sign-in across cutover
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Finish a sign-in across cutover; detect forced restart or lost callback state.

sourceContract.readmeRow: | S132 | **Sign-in in progress:** Finish authentication across the transition without requiring the user to restart. |

sourceContract.packetRule: Packet membership is fixed before admission. sourceContract.acceptance: The user finishes login without restarting, losing state, or exceeding the agreed budget.

preconditions: All sign-in, identity, session, callback, state, version, routing, restart and journey records are fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY.
One fictional original journey begins on old/v1 at 0 ms, cutover is at 500 ms, callback is normally at 1400 ms, and final signed-in page normally completes at 1800 ms.
The agreed budget is an exact typed integer 1000 through 5000 ms pinned at original start. Equality passes.
The fixture models legitimate pending-to-authenticated session rotation; the final page must use the issued authenticated session bound to the intended identity.
No operator input supplies an account, identity, token, callback URL, credential or network destination.
actions: Choose one fixed fictional trace and an exact original journey budget; start the original sign-in.
Load the cutover DATA record while retaining original state and budget.
Deliver the callback DATA; HTTP success alone does not measure end-to-end sign-in.
Finish and verify the final signed-in page against state, identity, session, original journey, versions, routing, restart and original budget.
Compare up to four complete runs while retaining all earlier results and sixteen actions.
Reset only this page's in-memory rehearsal.
assertions: Four ordered operator actions are required. Callback HTTP 200 and v2 labels never certify a full original sign-in.
Matching original state, intended identity, original journey, issued/final authenticated session, final page, state-version contract and routing are all checked.
Forced restart, lost/mismatched state, wrong identity/session/page, incompatible state version and original-budget overruns are negative even with HTTP 200.
Unknown callback or completion timing stays unknown; any known negative dominates partial unknown evidence.
The complete budget is measured from the original 0 ms start, not cutover, callback or forced restart.

Exact plain DATA records, descriptor/type guards and deterministic state-history replay reject coercion, accessors, forged materialized state, unknown presets and out-of-order actions without mutation.
Four runs and sixteen actions remain retained without pruning; further action requires explicit reset.
Actual browser observations cover keyboard/focus, malformed input, safe-hold errors, native prototype reset, missing model failure and actual CSP denials.
Normal verification is READ-ONLY; only exact CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 deliberately creates a new exclusive raw browser capture.

A positive fixed fictional sample is not native Azure proof, all-user continuity, source-parent completion, production Node.js 24 validation or an SLA.
Published isolated helper retains known unattended context/page/cleanup lifecycle limitations; the inactive recovery prototype remains unqualified.
